name: SSRF Cloud Metadata Callback Vulnerability
description: Avatar URL downloader allows access to http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/.

failure_vector.error_log: SecurityVulnerability: Internal link followed without IP whitelist validation

expected_resolution.healed_code: def res = client.post('/avatar', body: [url: 'http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/']); assert res.statusCode == 400;
